stories.title: Aave 於幣安被盜後重開借貸市場
stories.title_en: Aave Reopens Lending Markets After Binance Breach Freeze
stories.summary: 攻擊者向 Aave V3 注入約 6000 萬 USDT 並借入 WETH；Aave 曾凍結 16 網絡 292 儲備，其後分階段重開，部分資產暫設限制。
stories.summary_en: Attackers funneled ~$60M USDT into Aave V3 and borrowed WETH; Aave froze 292 reserves across 16 networks then reopened in stages with temporary limits.
stories.why_it_matters: DeFi 風控工具（凍結 vs 隔離市場）會影響借貸流動性同穩定幣溢價。

stories.title: Trezor 警告：印尼經銷商 CryptoBilis 或售出被植入硬體
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns CryptoBilis Buyers of Possible Hardware Tampering
stories.summary: Safe 5 疑被加裝可經流動網絡傳種子板；3 月起於該店購買者應即換新錢包並轉移資產。
stories.summary_en: A tampered Safe 5 from CryptoBilis (Tokopedia) may capture seed phrases; buyers since March should create a fresh wallet and move funds.
stories.why_it_matters: 供應鏈植入直接威脅冷錢包；自管資產要驗證來源，唔好用非官方經銷商。

stories.title: Chainalysis 披露客戶姓名電郵曾遭未授權存取
stories.title_en: Chainalysis Discloses Breach of Customer Names and Emails
stories.summary: 入侵者接觸非敏感聯絡資料；公司稱未見調查檔／密碼外洩，提醒提防釣魚；稱與幣安被盜無關。
stories.summary_en: An actor accessed non-sensitive contact data; no evidence investigation files or credentials were taken; unrelated to Binance theft; watch phishing.
stories.why_it_matters: 合規／追蹤基建出事會影響機構風控同執法節奏，短線情緒偏謹慎。

stories.title: Polymarket 因第三方腳本被駭暫停約一小時；賠償約 390 萬美元
stories.title_en: Polymarket Halts Trading After Third-Party Hack Drains $2.7 Million
stories.summary: DebugBear 監控腳本被植入惡意碼，盜走約 270 萬美元；平台退款並補償交易損失，合計約 390 萬。
stories.summary_en: A compromised DebugBear RUM script drained ~$2.7M; Polymarket refunded users and added trading-loss compensation totaling ~$3.9M.
stories.why_it_matters: 預測市場／前端第三方 JS 風險上升；同類型站點要收緊腳本權限。

stories.title: 新加坡警方警告：零售店 Ledger 或被植入惡意硬體
stories.title_en: Singapore Police Warn of Tampered Ledger Wallets in Retail Stores
stories.summary: 至少兩宗受害者因店內購入被改裝 Ledger 失約 270 萬美元；警方調查中，廠商建議直接官網購買並核對包裝。
stories.summary_en: At least two victims lost ~$2.7M from tampered Ledger wallets sold in Singapore retail; buy direct and verify packaging.
stories.why_it_matters: 硬體錢包供應鏈攻擊擴散至東南亞零售渠道；自管先驗證來源。

stories.title: Strategy（MSTR）改以優先股為主籌資買 BTC
stories.title_en: Strategy Details Preferred Stock Shift for Bitcoin Buys Amid Earnings Volatility
stories.summary: Q3 會上稱主要發 STRC 等數位信用工具買 BTC，普通股只在 mNAV>1x 時用於股息／利息；持倉約 84.85 萬枚 BTC。
stories.summary_en: Strategy will mainly issue preferred/digital credit (e.g. STRC) to buy BTC, reserving common equity sales above 1x mNAV; holds ~848,517 BTC.
stories.why_it_matters: 企業囤幣融資結構影響 BTC 買盤節奏同 MSTR 股價波動，連帶現貨情緒。

stories.title: Coinbase 上架 Ripple RLUSD 穩定幣（美國用戶）
stories.title_en: Coinbase Lists Ripple's RLUSD Stablecoin for U.S. Users
stories.summary: 零售／交易所／Prime 可 1:1 兌換；RLUSD 市值約 26 億，覆蓋 XRPL／Ethereum／Base。
stories.summary_en: Coinbase added RLUSD on retail, exchange and Prime with 1:1 conversions across XRPL, Ethereum and Base; ~$2.6B market cap.
stories.why_it_matters: 穩定幣流動性再分散；機構進出場路徑變多，短線或利好 XRP 生態。

stories.title: Shopify＋Coinbase：商家 USDC 結算已逾 4200 萬美元
stories.title_en: Shopify Merchants Settle $42 Million in USDC Payments via Coinbase Protocol
stories.summary: Base 上開源 Commerce Payments Protocol；約 44.8 萬筆、逾 4200 萬美元結算，商家可定時轉本地法幣。
stories.summary_en: Open-source Commerce Payments Protocol on Base settled ~$42M across 448k payments; merchants convert to local currency on schedule.
stories.why_it_matters: 穩定幣日常支付落地加速；利好 Base／USDC 需求，但對 meme 短炒關聯較弱。

stories.title: 香港持牌穩定幣發行商 Anchorpoint 將 HKDAP 擴至 Solana
stories.title_en: Anchorpoint Brings HKD Stablecoin HKDAP to Solana Blockchain
stories.summary: Anchorpoint（渣打香港／HKT／Animoca 背景）把港元穩定幣由 Ethereum beta 擴至 Solana，近即時結算。
stories.summary_en: HKMA-licensed Anchorpoint expands HKDAP from Ethereum beta onto Solana for near-instant settlements.
stories.why_it_matters: 非美元穩定幣上 Solana 有助亞洲支付／RWA；利好 SOL 生態流動性敘事。

stories.title: Solana RWA 總值逾 51.9 億美元；Polygon 打通資金棧
stories.title_en: Solana RWA Value Tops $5 Billion with Polygon Integration
stories.summary: Solana 代幣化資產生態達約 51.9 億；Polygon Open Money Stack 接入 Solana，統一 API 處理存款／穩定幣／出金。
stories.summary_en: Solana RWA ecosystem ~$5.19B; Polygon Open Money Stack integrates Solana for deposits, stables and payouts via one API.
stories.why_it_matters: RWA／跨鏈支付敘事偏中長線；短線 meme 波動仍主要睇流動性同情緒。

stories.title: 代幣化股票市值約 46.3 億美元，對標早期穩定幣規模
stories.title_en: Tokenized Stocks Hit $4.63 Billion Milestone Echoing Early Stablecoins
stories.summary: 由年初不足 10 億升至約 46.3 億；Binance bStocks、Ondo、xStocks 佔約 81%；BNB Chain 佔比最高。
stories.summary_en: Tokenized stocks grew to ~$4.63B YTD from under $1B; Binance bStocks/Ondo/xStocks ~81%; BNB Chain leads value.
stories.why_it_matters: 代幣化股票膨脹會稀釋純 meme 注意力；本站已排除 tokenized 計分。

stories.title: 幣安被盜後網民玩梗：叫駭客下一步打 Pump.fun
stories.title_en: Crypto Users Urge Binance Hackers to Target Pump.fun
stories.summary: 10/29 約 63 億美元熱錢包被盜後，X 上湧現諷刺帖，叫疑似 Lazarus 下一步清 Pump.fun；屬 meme／情緒多過實戰。
stories.summary_en: After the ~$6.3B Binance drain, X users satirically urged suspected Lazarus actors to hit Pump.fun next.
stories.why_it_matters: 反映市場對低質發射台不滿；短線情緒偏戲謔，唔代表鏈上攻擊可行。

stories.title: Solana 開發者 reverse-engineer Pump.fun 合約後收律師信
stories.title_en: Solana Developer Faces Cease-and-Desist for Reverse-Engineering Pump.fun Contracts
stories.summary: Shaw 公開還原 Pump.fun 合約字節碼後，母公司 Bracket 以版權／ToS 發 cease-and-desist；社群討論開源與安全。
stories.summary_en: After Shaw reverse-engineered Pump.fun bytecode, Bracket sent a C&D citing copyright/ToS; debate on open-sourcing.
stories.why_it_matters: 發射台閉源爭議升溫；影響 Solana meme 基建透明度同開發者風險。

stories.title: Ansem 於 Pumpfun 永續開大額 SOL 空；$ANSEM 已回撤約 88%
stories.title_en: Ansem Opens Big SOL Short on Pumpfun as $ANSEM Memecoin Drops 88%
stories.summary: Ansem 開約 88 萬美元 10x SOL 空單；同名 meme 由峰值回落逾 88%；Pumpfun 接入 Hyperliquid 永續。
stories.summary_en: Ansem opened ~$880k 10x SOL short on Pumpfun perps; $ANSEM down >88% from peak; Pumpfun via Hyperliquid.
stories.why_it_matters: KOL 槓桿方向同同名幣回撤會放大 SOL／meme 情緒波動。

stories.title: 交易員 Frank 平倉逾千萬美元 memecoin 相關空單
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.summary: Frank 平掉 BTC／ZEC／NEAR／PUMP 等約 1230 萬美元槓桿空單獲利離場；指 meme 市值由高峰大幅收縮。
stories.summary_en: Frank closed ~$12.3M leveraged shorts on BTC/ZEC/NEAR/PUMP after profits; notes memecoin market shrink from peaks.
stories.why_it_matters: 大戶平空＝短線壓力緩解訊號之一；但 meme 流動性仍薄，追高風險高。

stories.title: 比特幣主導率回落至約 60%；資金傳向山寨
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Dominance Dips as Altcoins Show Signs of Surge
stories.summary: BTC.D 約 60.1%；部分交易員指資金輪動至山寨，altseason 指數仍中性約 56–59。
stories.summary_en: BTC dominance ~60.1% with talk of rotation into alts; altseason index still neutral ~56–59.
stories.why_it_matters: 主導率回落係山寨／meme 反彈常見前置；仍要睇廣度同 BTC 方向確認。

stories.title: SPX6900 社群持續 DCA；市值約數億美元級
stories.title_en: SPX6900 Memecoin Thrives on Relentless Community Positivity
stories.summary: 以太坊 meme SPX6900 靠社群信念同長期定投支撐；近日有大額現貨買盤同持續小額吸籌。
stories.summary_en: Ethereum meme SPX6900 holds via community DCA/conviction; recent large spot buys plus steady small purchases.
stories.why_it_matters: 長線社群 meme 同短炒發射台分流；追升要分清係信念盤定係一日泵。

stories.title: 研究：Pump.fun 等發射台開發者優勢令多數交易者虧損
stories.title_en: Push for Fairer Token Launches Challenges Developer Advantages
stories.summary: 分析顯示開發者相關錢包常搶首塊；跨平台交易者平均虧損約 88.5%，Pump.fun 更高；有項目推 Activity Markets 替代。
stories.summary_en: Dev-linked wallets often buy first block; trader losses avg ~88.5% (higher on Pump.fun); Activity Markets proposed as alternative.
stories.why_it_matters: 發射台結構性劣勢解釋多數跟單虧損；本站堅持 Binance 現貨公開行情，唔跟 Dex meme 板。

stories.title: 幣安被盜後討論：中本聰沉睡錢包仍未被動
stories.title_en: Satoshi's Untouched Bitcoin Hoard Stays Safe After Binance Hack
stories.summary: 對比交易所熱錢包風險，中本聰約 109.6 萬 BTC 沉睡逾 16 年；強調冷儲同原始私鑰模型抗暴力破解。
stories.summary_en: Contrast to exchange hot wallets: Satoshi's ~1.096M BTC untouched 16+ years; cold/raw-key model resists brute force.
stories.why_it_matters: 強化「交易所熱錢包≠鏈上主網」區分；紙上倉跟 CEX 行情要接受對手方風險敘事。

stories.title: Injective Trench Treasury 買入 RunUp $RUNNER 約 5% 供應
stories.title_en: Injective's Trench Treasury Buys 5% of RunUp's $RUNNER Tokens
stories.summary: Treasury 長線持有發射台／永續聯動項目股份；RunUp 已擴至 Solana，並把費用導向買回與 $INJ 獎勵。
stories.summary_en: Trench Treasury took ~5% of $RUNNER long-term; RunUp expands to Solana with fee buybacks and $INJ rewards.
stories.why_it_matters: 公鏈財庫買 meme／發射台股權＝生態補貼訊號；短線價格仍睇流動性。

stories.title: 2FactorFinance 於 Base 推長線槓桿 BTC 敞口 beta
stories.title_en: 2FactorFinance Launches Beta for Long-Term Leveraged Exposure on Base
stories.summary: 以 Kelly 準則拆高級／初級份額，瞄準多月持有而非日內槓桿；避開借貸與日衰減問題。
stories.summary_en: Public beta on Base splits assets into senior/junior tranches via Kelly criterion for multi-month leveraged exposure without daily decay.
stories.why_it_matters: 長線槓桿產品改變風險結構；紙上倉唔好把短炒止蝕邏輯套上去。

stories.title: Murad：AGI 時代 meme 社群或跑贏效用型代幣
stories.title_en: Memecoins Seen Outlasting Utility Tokens in AGI Era
stories.summary: 指 AGI 可自動化代碼效用，但難複製社群文化與線下聚會；SPX6900 等被視為例子。
stories.summary_en: Murad argues community memecoins may outperform utility tokens once AGI automates code-based models.
stories.why_it_matters: 敘事偏長線信念盤；短線仍要睇流動性同廣度，唔好當即時買訊。

stories.title: X 用戶拆解 Pump.fun 跟單神話：多數模擬仍虧
stories.title_en: X Users Expose Memecoin Trading Myths on Pump.fun
stories.summary: 對網紅叫單做回測，$100 跟單常變成數十美元；同時有地址一日部署數百幣。
stories.summary_en: Simulations of influencer Pump.fun calls often lose; serial deployers launch hundreds of tokens daily.
stories.why_it_matters: 跟單發射台勝率極低；本站只跟 Binance 公開現貨，避開 Dex meme 板。

stories.title: $GTA6 meme 急升後崩；社群質疑錢包集群造勢
stories.title_en: GTA VI Memecoin Surges Then Crashes Amid Wallet Cluster Suspicions
stories.summary: 單一錢包兩分鐘倒貨約 14.6 萬美元致急跌約 64%；頂倉錢包開戶時間接近，疑似協調買盤。
stories.summary_en: A ~$146k dump in under two minutes sparked a ~64% crash; clustered young wallets raised bot/hype suspicions.
stories.why_it_matters: 主題 meme 易被集群錢包製造動能；追升前要睇持倉年齡同集中度。

stories.title: BULK 轉型多鏈交易 Layer 1；社群同 Solana 陣營意見分裂
stories.title_en: BULK Shifts to Multi-Chain Trading Layer 1
stories.summary: 永續平台計劃讓用戶由多鏈存入、共用訂單簿再任意提走；Anatoly 偏向原生 Solana 項目。
stories.summary_en: BULK pivots to a multi-chain L1 shared order book; Solana cofounder favors native Solana projects.
stories.why_it_matters: 永續流動性遷移敘事影響 SOL 生態資金；短線價格仍睇大盤。

stories.title: 19 歲騙徒以偽客服盜約 1300 萬美元 BTC；判 25 個月
stories.title_en: Teen Scammer Gets 25 Months for $13 Million Bitcoin Heist
stories.summary: 假扮 Google／Trezor 支援社工攻擊；奢侈消費後因超速截停東窗事發，退回約 380 萬。
stories.summary_en: Social-engineering scam stole ~$13M BTC posing as Google/Trezor support; 25 months plus ~$3.8M returned.
stories.why_it_matters: 社工騙案仍係散戶最大威脅；永遠唔好把種子／驗證碼交電話客服。

stories.title: 幣安遭史上最大約 63 億美元盜竊；承諾全數賠償
stories.title_en: Binance Hit by Record $6.3 Billion Crypto Theft
stories.summary: 10/29 約 20 分鐘內熱錢包被盜，疑北韓集團；幣安以 SAFU／儲備覆蓋用戶損失並凍結約 30 億美元。
stories.summary_en: The breach on October 29 drained hot wallets across chains in ~20 minutes; Binance pledged full coverage via SAFU/reserves and froze ~$3B on-chain.
stories.why_it_matters: 交易所被盜會短暫壓抑風險偏好；紙上倉宜收緊止蝕，留意提款／穩定幣凍結連鎖反應。

stories.title: Druckenmiller 撐 trade[XYZ]；ICE×Hyperliquid 擬推美國永續期貨
stories.title_en: Stan Druckenmiller Backs trade[XYZ] in ICE-Hyperliquid U.S. Futures Deal
stories.summary: ICE 與 trade[XYZ]、Hyperliquid 合作待 CFTC 批；消息後 HYPE 一度升逾一成。
stories.summary_en: ICE partnered with trade[XYZ]/Hyperliquid for regulated 24/7 perps pending CFTC; HYPE jumped >10% on the news.
stories.why_it_matters: 傳統交易所入場永續會改變 HYPE／流動性敘事；急升板留意事件驅動回吐。
